mentions.name: Fibonacci Sphere Drone Synth Visualizer
mentions.description: A web-based synthesizer drone generator built with the Web Audio API, paired with an audio visualizer made in Three.js. The visualizer renders a fibonacci sphere of 100,000 particles; a sine wave is sent down the spiral, highlighting the different spiral paths contained within the larger fibonacci spiral to produce evolving patterns. The audio component is currently in development.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a synthesizer drone generator (Webaudio API) with an audio visualizer (Three.js). It's a fibonacci sphere made of 100k particles.
